text_block_list.text:
It was when I spoke on the phone with Ines 
Fujin's mother after the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"—'My girls... My two little sisters at 
home said they want to go watch the Arima 
Kinen.'"

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"I'm in the hospital, and I asked my 
husband to stay by her side. We're truly 
sorry for being such pathetic parents, 
but..."

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"'...I want the three of them to meet 
face-to-face and talk it out. Trainer, 
could I ask you to help make that 
happen?'"

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry for dragging you into my 
family's affairs, Trainer."
choice_data_list:
No, I'm just glad if I could be of help to 
her.

text_block_list.name: Ines's Mother
text_block_list.text:
""...Thank you so much. Please, take good 
care of my girls...!""

Ines Fujin's behavior up until now, and 
the flow of the conversation with her 
younger sisters.

Those sisters seem to have a 
misunderstanding. Perhaps a third party 
stepping in could provide a moment for 
them to cool off and calm down.

First, I'll ask Ines Fujin whether she 
wants to spectate or run in the Arima 
Kinen. And then, on the day of the race—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...So both of you came.

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister B
text_block_list.text:
You're running in the Arima Kinen too, Big 
Sis! Do your very, very best... okay?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry. As your big sister, I 
haven't kept a single promise I made to 
you two."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"I still haven't saved up enough to hire a 
maid for a whole year. And the Kikuka 
Sho... I made everyone worry."

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister B
text_block_list.text: No. You see, both Ruu and Suu...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Still! I'll definitely see it through! So 
you two don't have to worry about the 
house, or helping out, or...!

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text:
...I will! Both Su and Lu will help out 
too. We even learned how to do the 
laundry!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Suu-chan.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Why?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Don't push yourself. You two have your own 
dreams, don't you? So you don't need to 
say things like that...!

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text:
No! Both Su and Lu decided for ourselves! 
We chose to quit dancing and help Mom out!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
No, you were *forced* to decide that! 
Because of me! You were forced to give up!

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, Sis's--
choice_data_list:
Aren't you the one jumping to conclusions, 
Agnes?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Trainer...?
choice_data_list:
I wonder what your little sisters' dreams 
are?

I wonder what your little sisters' dreams 
are?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...That is...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Devoting myself to my passion for dancing 
every day. Maybe even winning a contest or 
something...

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text: ...That's, not true.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text:
Both Lou and I love seeing our whole 
family smiling.

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text:
That's why I like dancing too. Because 
when I dance, everyone smiles. But...

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister B
text_block_list.text:
...What Ruu and the others love even more 
is watching Big Sis work hard and run!

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister B
text_block_list.text:
For Big Sister to run a lot, smile a lot, 
and win lots of first places...

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister B
text_block_list.text:
It's all of our family's dream right 
now...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Ruu-chan, Suu-chan.

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fuujin-san! It's almost time for the 
paddock~!
choice_data_list:
Ines, did you hear what your little 
sisters said?

Ines, did you hear what your little 
sisters said?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
choice_data_list:
Your running isn't just your own selfish 
wish anymore.

Your running isn't just your own whim 
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
If it's not my selfishness... then what is 
it?
choice_data_list: It's my dream, and theirs too.
It's my dream, and theirs too

text_block_list.text:
"—On the day of this 'Arima Kinen,' the 
grandstands, the paddock, and everywhere 
else were utterly packed with people."

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
So basically~ everyone's trying to bear 
witness to Oguri's final run~.

text_block_list.name: False-Eyelash Gal
text_block_list.text:
I know. Oguri's, like, a super amazing 
horse girl, right? And?

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
...Still~. Apparently she hasn't been in 
good shape lately. There's a rumor that 
this might be her last run.

text_block_list.name: Oguri's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Oguri...! Do your best...! I believe in 
you—I know you'll take 1st place...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri's Fan B
text_block_list.text: Please, Ogurin—!! Run... Don't lose—!!

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
Aaaand, everyone was saying this girl 
named Mejiro Ryan, who's kinda Ines's 
rival, was gonna win, y'know~?

text_block_list.name: False-Eyelash Gal
text_block_list.text:
"...I mean, you've really gotten 
knowledgeable about racing, haven't you?"

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't it way more fun to watch Ines's 
races when you actually understand what's 
going on?"

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Well now, hey there, you two gals! You 
come out for the Arima too~?

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
Boss! Wait, is it really okay to leave the 
convenience store? Did you just lock up 
and close!?

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Listen here, how many part-timers do you 
think I've hired? Taking one day off isn't 
gonna hurt. ...Ah, speak of the devil.

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
There are days when seeing her run gives 
me a boost of energy, too.
(Woooooaaaaahhh!)
